summary: A notice from Alex McKenzie at BBN that Vint Cerf's UCLA group would run heavy-traffic performance experiments on the network on May 8, 1972. These could lock up the network so that no traffic flows, a problem the upcoming new IMP software was meant to prevent. Sites were advised not to schedule important network work that day.

eli5.summary: Some people will test what happens when the road is jammed with lots of cars, and the road might get stuck. So everyone is told not to plan an important trip that day.

questions: why did the arpanet lock up in 1972
